input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix: resolve all TypeScript errors in deploy-cloudflare package

- Fix worker/api.ts server/src import paths (3→4 levels up from src/worker/)
- Extend RunLogStoreType and WorkspaceOperationLogStoreType to include "r2"
  so R2-backed stores satisfy the server's discriminated union
- Downgrade deploy-cloudflare drizzle-orm to ^0.38.4 to match packages/db
  and eliminate implicit-any errors on Drizzle .then() callbacks
- Cast R2Provider as never in boot.ts registerStorageProvider (Web Streams
  vs Node Readable stream mismatch is intentional in CF runtime)
- Map membershipRole null→"" to satisfy non-nullable ActorMembership type
- Cast Uint8Array as BufferSource in cf-storage-service sha256Hex (TS version quirk)
- Add postgres dep and fix tsconfig module/moduleResolution/rootDir overrides

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
